prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a hit while turning left claim. Injury: knee injury. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1409; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Insured reports a left-turn collision at a signalized intersection. Insured states the other vehicle was approaching from the opposite direction. Recorded statement taken. Photos requested from insured and scene.

Entry 2: Claimant's vehicle inspected at repair facility. Driver-side front damage consistent with insured's account. Repair estimate received and under review. Liability position still being evaluated pending police report.

Entry 3: Claimant is now represented by counsel. All further contact to be routed through the attorney's office. Letter of representation received and placed in file. Claimant reports a knee injury and has started treatment.

Entry 4: Medical records requested through counsel for the claimed knee injury. Authorization forms sent. Police report obtained, which lists the insured as the turning vehicle. Liability leaning toward insured, subject to review of witness statements.

Entry 5: Counsel has submitted a demand package including treatment notes and a claim for medical costs and lost time. Demand is under review by the adjuster and claims supervisor. Reserve reviewed and updated. Next step is an independent medical review of the knee injury records.
